name: 68132 · Omaha, NE
findings: ZIP 68132 (Omaha) has 75 nonprofit organizations. 43 of them (57%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 33 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 68132 (Omaha) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 68132 (Omaha) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 4.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 21 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
